uk.text: Java 8 має кілька особливих bytecode-патернів: lambdas часто компілюються через invokedynamic і LambdaMetafactory; generics стираються до raw descriptors; try-with-resources генерує код із suppressed exceptions; enhanced for над Iterable перетворюється на Iterator.

lambda	invokedynamic + synthetic/static helper method або method handle
method reference	invokedynamic call site
generics	erased descriptors + Signature attribute
enhanced for над Iterable	iterator(), hasNext(), next()
try-with-resources	try/finally + close + suppressed exceptions
String concat у JDK 8	StringBuilder chain
switch String	hashCode + equals + tableswitch/lookupswitch
checkcast після Iterator.next з'являється через generics erasure: Iterator у runtime повертає Object, а компілятор вставляє cast до String.

en.text: Java 8 has several special bytecode patterns: lambdas often compile through invokedynamic and LambdaMetafactory; generics erase to raw descriptors; try-with-resources generates code with suppressed exceptions; enhanced for over Iterable becomes Iterator.

lambda	invokedynamic + synthetic/static helper method or method handle
method reference	invokedynamic call site
generics	erased descriptors + Signature attribute
enhanced for over Iterable	iterator(), hasNext(), next()
try-with-resources	try/finally + close + suppressed exceptions
String concat in JDK 8	StringBuilder chain
switch String	hashCode + equals + tableswitch/lookupswitch
checkcast after Iterator.next appears because of generics erasure: Iterator at runtime returns Object, and the compiler inserts a cast to String.

Compile lambda Runnable and find invokedynamic.
Compile enhanced for over List<String> and find Iterator calls.
Compile String concat in JDK 8 and find StringBuilder.
Compile try-with-resources and find close and suppressed handling.
Compile List<String>.get(0) and find checkcast.
